_comment: SUPERSEDED by F10_interpreter (ADR 0079, 2026-09-06): the op-grammar these keys exercised is retired by the never-regex law. Kept as the historical record of the ADR-0078 console. Ask-console answer keys (ADR 0078), authored BEFORE the build. Families: index (totality + drift-by-name), outcomes (matched/ambiguous/no-match + H5 usage), ops (each closed op over the sepsis corpus). Runnable via tests/aivia/test_ask_console.py.

index.title: every KG1 column is findable
expected: index entries >= KG1 column count; every column identity present

index.title: drift names findable (the search law); key corrected at build: DATE_STAMP is BOTH computed (derived member) and drift — ambiguity lists the whole story, the drift identity yields the finding
expected: 'DATE_STAMP' -> ambiguous with drift AND derived-column candidates
picking the drift identity -> the reader/writer drift finding, never silence

index.title: named scopes findable; CROSS-FILE same-name scopes are honestly ambiguous, resolvable by full identity (key corrected at build: #Base_Pop_ED_Readmit lives in TWO files)
expected: '#Base_Pop_ED_Readmit' -> AMBIGUOUS with both files' scopes as candidates
the full identity 'reporting/USP_ED_SEPSIS.sql::#Base_Pop_ED_Readmit' -> matched
'USP_ED_SEPSIS' file -> matched

outcomes.title: matched -> answer + usage event with about
outcomes.question: what is THERA_CLASS_CODE
expected: outcome matched
usage event action=asked outcome=matched with about set
answer text contains steward words, no raw-identifier-only response

outcomes.title: ambiguous -> candidates, human picks
outcomes.question: what is TIME_LINE
expected: outcome ambiguous (TIME_LINE is a DERIVED COLUMN defined in several scopes; derived columns joined the index at build)
candidates listed with kinds
usage event has NO about (H5)

outcomes.title: no-match -> honest, counted, nearest offered
outcomes.question: what is FLUX_CAPACITOR_ID
expected: outcome no-match
usage event outcome=no-match, no about
payload is phi-gated question text

outcomes.title: replay determinism (Group E)
outcomes.question: lineage of ED_ENCOUNTERS_DM
expected: same question twice -> byte-identical rendered answer

ops.question: what is reporting.IP_SEPSIS
expected: the table's description words
kind table

ops.question: filters on THERA_CLASS_CODE
expected: the antibiotics filter voiced through the DICTIONARY words (key corrected at build: the demo dictionary describes THERA_CLASS_CODE, so R5 renders its words, not the readable-name fallback): '... is 11 (annotated 'Antibiotics' in the source)'

ops.question: lineage of ED_ENCOUNTERS_DM
expected: scopes reading the table listed (the readmit scope among them)

ops.question: who reads PATIENTS
expected: files reading it listed; empty usage honestly stated

ops.question: gaps
expected: the taxonomy rollup: ruled-silent / engine / estate + drift count

ops.question: what is reporting/USP_ED_SEPSIS.sql::#Base_Pop_ED_Readmit
expected: the scope's FLOOR text: composition sentence + both bullets — the node answers for itself, no answer shape
